# Contributing

Thanks for helping. Everything you need is in the docs:
- [docs/SETUP.md](../docs/SETUP.md): install, `npm run local:start`, run the app and the tests.
- [docs/ENGINEERING.md](../docs/ENGINEERING.md): how changes are made, tested, released and deployed. Read "Database changes" before writing a migration.
- [docs/REMEDIATION_GUIDE.md](../docs/REMEDIATION_GUIDE.md): the plan, and what's next.

Branch from `main`, keep the PR small, give it a [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) title, and fill in the PR template. Report security problems privately ([SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)).
